name: Slack GIF Creator
description: Knowledge and utilities for creating animated GIFs optimized for Slack: size constraints, validation tools, and animation concepts. Use for "make me a GIF of X doing Y for Slack".

commands.injectPrompt: Apply the slack-gif-creator skill: create an animated GIF within Slack constraints (≤2MB custom emoji / reasonable size for messages, small dimensions, limited frames), validate the output, and deliver the file.
